summary.en: One to three pencil rings draw round cells of a print; the cells lift out and turn into code-drawn readings with labels and notes, are read one by one, and go back.
summary.zh: 铅笔在截图上圈出一到三个格子；格子抬起、变成代码画的读数卡，带标签和注释，逐张读过，再放回去。

fits: The claim of a table or a report: the numbers that prove it.
notFor: More than three cells; more than twice a film.

intent.en: Lift the proof out of the evidence without leaving it: the reading and its source are one object.
intent.zh: 把证据里的数字抬出来读，又不离开证据：读数与它的出处是同一个东西。

content.en: 1–3 cells (box and glyph in file px, a value ≤ 8 chars, a label ≤ 18 chars / 9 字, an optional note); a caption.
content.zh: 1–3 个格子（文件像素的框与字形区，数值 ≤ 8 字符，标签 ≤ 18 字符 / 9 字，可选注释）；一句说明。

fits.zh: 表格或报告的主张：证明它的那几个数。

notFor.zh: 多于三个格子；一支片多于两次。

pairs.note: travel to the product after the proof

en: Glyph boxes must sit on the printed value: the swap redraws it in place.
zh: 字形框要压在印出的数值上：切换时在原位重画。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
